questions.question: What came down and consumed the burnt offering when Solomon finished praying?
What did God say his people should do to be forgiven and have their land healed?
options: Build many more temples to the LORD throughout the land
Humble themselves, pray, seek his face, and turn from wicked ways
Offer far greater and more frequent numbers of sacrifices
Make strong military alliances with all of their many neighboring nations
questions.answer: Humble themselves, pray, seek his face, and turn from wicked ways

questions.question: The glory of the LORD filled the temple so the priests could not enter.
